scripts.deploy:firebase: node -e "if (process.env.PORTAL_DATA_RELEASE_APPROVED !== 'true') { console.error('Hosting release blocked: verify and migrate portal records before setting PORTAL_DATA_RELEASE_APPROVED=true.'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:rules && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
